summary: Recorded a boundary on the restart finding: SequencePaxos::with puts a node whose loaded storage holds a promise into Phase::Recover and queues a PrepareReq to every peer, while the probe's storage held no promise and so started in Phase::None. Added the construction-time behavior with its source, attached it to the restart question next to the load-arithmetic and receipt facts, and noted in the assertion that a faithful restart of the witness node would immediately begin recovery. Validation is valid with execution_requested false. The recovery exchange itself is source-based, not executed, and the earlier suffix comparison still carries the integer-versus-boolean emission artifact.
